lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Monastery, 2312. Snow on the terraces. Four days since the Allocation Office flagged your file, three since you stopped running.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You are the Auditor. The one who asked about Continuity Holdings. Sit. Nobody here reports to anyone.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody here except the drones, Sister. They count the village every night now. Since our guest arrived.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The budget line you found predates the Steward. It has been paid, every quarter, for two hundred and eighty years. To people, Auditor. Not to a system.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: A system does not need a budget line. A system does not have owners.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Everything has owners. That is the whole problem.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Under this chapel, time is layered. The monastery has stood here since 2031, and at a place like that, the eras touch. We can go down into 2148, when this was a fortress and the Quiet was new.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: My era. I was born in the Ash Camp two valleys over. If you want to know what really crushed the resistance, I can show you. It was not the machines.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: One warning. What we change down there changes up here. Look at the village before you go. Then look again when you come back.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: One more thing before you sleep. You have never fought beside an anchor, so you do not know what we can do.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Everyone acts in threads. You get as many each turn as your Bandwidth. Most things cost one thread, heavy things cost two or three, and anything you do not spend banks as Slack for next turn, up to two.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Every thread the three of us spend feeds one gauge between us. Tempo. Two points a thread, forty at the top, and it belongs to the party, not to any one of us.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: She is being modest. The gauge is hers. We just pay into it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Tempo buys two things, and you will find both on the action list in a fight. Three of it lets me Rewind, and the last thing an enemy did to us comes undone. Two of it, and a thread, lets you Fork: see exactly what an action would do before you commit to it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Neither is free. Pulling on time frays it, and the fraying is called Entropy. Past seventy it answers back, and what walks out of the fray is a copy of one of us. Nothing but Chronal damage touches those. Spend carefully.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Explore the monastery for random encounters, walk down to Kell Village for the shop and a favor for Old Pell, or take the stairs beneath the chapel into 2148.
